nodes.label: Graphify Skill
nodes.description: Claude Code skill that converts any folder of files (code, docs, papers, images, video) into a persistent knowledge graph with community detection, interactive HTML visualization, and query/path/explain tools.

nodes.label: Graphify Pipeline
nodes.description: 9-step pipeline: install → detect files → transcribe video → extract (AST + semantic parallel) → build graph → health check → label communities → generate outputs → save manifest.

nodes.label: Graphify AST Extraction (Part A)
nodes.description: Deterministic structural extraction of code files using AST parsing. No LLM required. Runs in parallel with semantic extraction.

nodes.label: Graphify Semantic Extraction (Part B)
nodes.description: LLM-based semantic extraction for docs, papers, and images dispatched as parallel subagents. Uses Gemini if API key set, otherwise host agent. Skipped for code-only corpora.

nodes.label: Graphify Community Detection
nodes.description: Graph clustering using community detection algorithms. Each community is labeled with a 2-5 word plain-language name. Cohesion scores are shown as raw numbers.

nodes.label: Graphify God Nodes
nodes.description: High-degree hub nodes that connect many communities. Identified by the god_nodes() analyzer and highlighted in GRAPH_REPORT.md as cross-cutting architectural anchors.
